newsitem.title: CHINA: China to issue 123 bln yuan of treasury bonds. [CORRECTED 11:45 GMT]
newsitem.headline: China to issue 123 bln yuan of treasury bonds. [CORRECTED 11:45 GMT]

text.p: China's Ministry of Finance will issue 123 billion yuan worth of two-, three- and five-year bonds, state radio said on Tuesday. It earlier erroneously reported the issue would total 123 million.
The bonds will be issued from March 1 and will close on October 20, the ministry said.
The ministry would issue 25 billion yuan worth of two-year bonds at annual interest of 8.64 percent, it said.
It would issue 73 billion yuan worth of three-year bonds at annual interest of 9.18 percent.
It would issue 25 billion worth of five-year bonds at annual interest of 10.17 percent.
The principal and interest would be repaid upon maturity, it said.
China has said it plans to issue about 240 billion yuan worth of state debt in 1997.
